public_rationale: Reuters reported on February 2, 2023, citing a UBS study using Similarweb data, that ChatGPT averaged about 13 million daily unique visitors in January 2023, more than double December 2022 [e5]. This increase supports the claim that more people were using chatbots over that period, with ChatGPT as the measured example [e5].
limitations: The evidence does not measure the combined, deduplicated audience across chatbots or establish growth for every chatbot.
Average daily unique visitors do not establish the number of distinct people using ChatGPT across an entire month.
The underlying UBS study and historical Similarweb measurement were not directly retrieved; the assessment relies on Reuters.

statement.excerpt: More and more people are using chatbots

our_interpretation: The plain reading is a recent rise in adoption of conversational AI, including general-purpose chatbots.
It does not require every chatbot to gain users or predict indefinite growth.
Use December 2022 through January 2023 to assess the trend through the latest complete calendar month before the post.
Comparable unique-user measures are informative; raw visits alone can rise without more people using a service.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable recent user measures show substantial growth in adoption of prominent conversational chatbots.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence shows that adoption was broadly stable or falling over the same period, making examples of growth unrepresentative.
